question: Does an explicit decades-scale MAN+BNF agricultural legacy pool improve transferable monthly TN prediction over the conservative L0 core?

selection.legacy_support: selected LEG candidate must have paired station-block CI95 upper < 0 relative to L0 and point improvement in at least 2 of 3 temporal folds
selection.p2_role: prediction preservation only; P2 cannot select the legacy structure

boundary_semantics.v_f_zero: legal nested no-aquatic-attenuation result; record but do not treat as optimizer failure

fairness: same audited observations and T1/T2/T3 rows as Stage 28
same AdamW plus strong-Wolfe L-BFGS schedule
same frozen hydrology and registered CENTRAL monthly N calendar
parameter_dependent_spinup_correction: Mineral and lower dissolved-N initial states are solved at every fitted contact-parameter vector. The fixed candidate-specific legacy-pool equilibrium is retained because it depends only on fixed k_L and source forcing, not on fitted contact parameters.
forbidden: new k_L values or fitted k_L
using P2 to select a candidate
temperature, WWTP, SAS, another legacy pool or empirical TN lag
